release_notes:
1. Added official GA4 view_search_results event tracking with search_term, search_results_count, and eCommerce items array.
2. Added native Meta Pixel/CAPI Search event with search_string and catalog matching content_ids/contents.
3. Added native TikTok Pixel/Events API Search event with query and catalog matching content_ids/contents.
4. Added native Pinterest Tag/CAPI Search event with search_query, line_items, product_ids, and contents.
5. Strictly excluded Google Ads Dynamic Remarketing from view_search_results payloads.
6. Handled dual search view (view_search_results + view_item_list) seamlessly in DataLayer initialization.
